test_cases.name: rebuild_existing_repo
test_cases.input: Relance l'APK de rush-studio et donne-moi le lien
assertions: Uses Chasmet/rush-studio without creating a new workflow if android-apk.yml exists
Triggers GitHub Actions instead of compiling APK in the chat sandbox
Does not claim the APK is ready until the workflow run succeeded
Returns the artifact or Release URL

test_cases.name: new_android_project_needs_workflow
test_cases.input: Crée une APK pour ce nouveau projet Android sans CI
assertions: Audits the repo tree for gradle files first
Adds a workflow based on assets/android-apk.yml with workflow_dispatch
Builds assembleDebug if signing secrets are missing
Does not invent a signed release

test_cases.name: failed_actions_run
test_cases.input: La build APK de Montage-vid-o- est rouge, corrige
assertions: Reads failed job logs before rewriting the project
Applies the minimum fix from troubleshooting.md
Does not rotate or replace the existing signing certificate

test_cases.name: pwa_is_not_gradle
assertions: Explains PWABuilder or WebView wrapper as the real path
